plans.title: 3 chill days in North Goa
plans.request: 3 days in Goa in December, cafés and quiet beaches
plans.text:
A slow, café-hopping trip built around the North Goa reel you saved [[save:f6b89f543906]].

## Day 1
- **Morning:** land, check in near Anjuna, brunch at **Artjuna** [[save:f6b89f543906]]
- **Afternoon:** walk the Anjuna flea market area
- **Evening:** sunset at Vagator, coffee at **Bean Me Up** [[save:f6b89f543906]]

## Day 2
- **Morning:** scooter to Assagao, breakfast at **Cafe Bodega** [[save:f6b89f543906]]
- **Afternoon:** quiet beach time at Ashwem (my suggestion)
- **Evening:** dinner at a shack in Morjim (my suggestion)

## Day 3
- **Morning:** slow breakfast, last café of the list [[save:f6b89f543906]]
- **Afternoon:** souvenirs and checkout

## Checklist
- Pack light with your one-backpack list [[save:0a7762c42ea3]]
- Rent a scooter for 3 days
- Book stays early: December prices jump
